entries.en: Fixed Claude Code failing to launch on macOS 12 (Monterey), a regression introduced in 2.1.255
entries.zh: 修复了 Claude Code 无法在 macOS 12 (Monterey) 上启动的问题，这是 2.1.255 中引入的回归问题

entries.en: Fixed remote and scheduled sessions failing with "user messages must have non-empty content" after a re-sent permission approval could not be applied
entries.zh: 修复了无法应用重新发送权限批准后远程和计划会话失败并显示“用户消息必须包含非空内容”的问题
